flow.name: 12 · Magic-text · jsonpath + regex extraction
flow.notes: Webhook → uses |jsonpath:$.id and |regex:\d+ magic-text modifiers to pull structured pieces out of the request body → stores them in vars → posts a notification showing the parsed pieces. Tests the magic-text modifier system end-to-end. Trigger: curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' http://127.0.0.1:8821/hook/extract --data '{"id":42,"name":"hello","count":17}'. Expect: id=42, firstNum=42, name=hello.
